description-experiment Propose, start, or read a two-arm tool-description\n rewrite experiment\n

ready finished)\n rerun [options] <run-id> Rerun a finished eval run's failed cases as a new\n run.

a

 iteratio
ns [options] List per-iteration results for an eval run\n (pass/fail, tool calls, tokens, latenc
y)\n gate [options] Apply a pass/fail policy to a finished eval run and\n set an exit cod
e (0 pass or waived, 1 eval failure,\n 2 usage, 3 incomplete)\n compare [options] Compare a
finished eval run against a baseline and\n set an exit code (0 pass, 1 regression, 2 usage, 3\n
incomplete)\n validate [options] Validate a local eval suite file offline — no auth,\n
no network unless --project is passed (0 valid, 1\n contract-invalid or unresolved ref
erence, 2\n unreadable/oversize/malformed)\n export [options] Write a hosted eval suite to
a local suite file,\n refusing anything it cannot represent losslessly\n pull [options] L
EGACY: materialize a hosted eval suite into a\n corpus lock for @mcpjam/vitest — new work should\n
use `eval export` (0 clean, 1 drift under --frozen,\n 2 usage, 3 incomplete)\
n trace [options] Fetch the full trace for one eval iteration (large:\n full message histo
ry + spans)\n steps [options] Per-authored-step results for one eval iteration:\n status (
ok/fail/skipped/pending), reason, and\n evidence (screenshot/video URLs). The fastest way\n
to see WHICH step failed and why.\n screenshot [options] Show the widget screenshot(s) an eval iteration\
n rendered — inline when the terminal supports it,\n otherwise the image U
RL\n video [options] Get the replay recording an eval iteration made —\n prints the URL, o
r downloads it with --out. A local\n widget run records a .webm; an unattended run on a\n
hosted browser records an .mp4\n get [options] Show an eval suite's full settings\n update [options
] Edit an eval suite's settings (only the flags you\n pass change)\n delete [options]
Permanently delete an eval suite (and its cases and\n runs)\n schedule [options] Enable
or disable scheduled runs for a suite\n environments Attach or detach the project environments an eval\n
suite runs against\n cases List, author, and edit an eval suite's test cases\n help [comm

ad a versioned suite file and run\nit. The upload-and-launch has a 120s deadline overall, not per request (raise it\nwith the glob

al --timeout <ms>); --wait-timeout bounds the RUN instead.

Options:
 --suite <id-or-name> Eval suite nam
e or ID\n --file <path> Versioned suite file to upload and run (.yaml or .json, or - for stdin)\n --
project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project)\n --server <id-or-name
...> Override the suite's saved server selection (HTTP servers only)\n --environment <id-or-name...>
Attached project environment(s) to run. Several values start one PAID RUN each.\n --client <id-or-name...> Atta
ched client(s) to run, so the run is stamped with that client's config. Several values start one PAID RUN each.\n --host <id-or-n
ame...> Deprecated alias for --client. NOT the host-compat catalog id `mcpjam tools --host` takes.\n --all-tar
gets Run EVERY attached environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one PAID RUN per target\n --
iterations <n> Run each case this many times under verdict policy 2 (1-10)\n --repetitions <n>
Legacy spelling of --iterations\n --case <id-or-title...> Run only these cases instead of the wh
ole suite\n --exclude-skills Run the 'without skills' arm: no skills are pinned, and the run is labelled
as excluded\n --refresh-snapshot PERSISTS a new host-config snapshot on the suite, changing every future
run of it. Single-target runs only.\n --notes <text> Free-text note stored on the run\n --min-pass-ra
te <n> Pass threshold for this run (0-100)\n --match-options <json> Tool-call match opti
ons for this run, e.g. '{\"toolCallOrder\":\"exact\"}'\n --idempotency-key <key> Retry key for a lost launch re
sponse; for --file, one is minted and printed when omitted\n --wait Wait for every started run
to reach a terminal status\n --wait-timeout <ms> Maximum time to wait for completion (default 600000; a ru
n held for its judge gets up to 31 more minutes unless this flag is set)\n --reporter <json-summary|junit-xml|html> Render the c
ompleted run report to stdout\n --out <path> Atomically write the completed report selected by --rep
